scope.question: What is the maximum safe automated improvement loop for a repository agent operating system, and how must every lifecycle state/transition be tested?
included: offline replay, zero-authority shadow, bounded canary, automatic abort and compatible rollback
formal plus executable state-machine models, event/reconciliation tests, fault injection and adversarial security tests
versioned conversational decisions as authority-bearing artifacts
excluded: candidate changing its own protected tests, graders, policy, permissions, promotion authority or audit
autonomous product intent, legal/privacy judgment, high-impact irreversible repair or exception approval
scope.definition: Fully self-improving means maximal safe automation supported by evidence: automatically observe, draft, evaluate, shadow, canary, abort and roll back inside a pre-approved reversible capability class. It does not mean self-governance. The candidate remains an untrusted proposer and experiment subject [S18-S26].

verified_capabilities.claim: Executable rule-based state-machine tests can generate action sequences, assert invariants and shrink failures [S3]; TLA+/TLC can specify and check bounded concurrent behaviors and safety/liveness properties [S4-S5].
verified_capabilities.limit: Neither proves the abstraction matches all production behavior or explores an unbounded state space.

verified_capabilities.claim: Workflow replay, history checking and injected faults are established techniques: Temporal documents replay-based safe-deployment checks [S6], while Jepsen supplies consistency models and many empirical fault analyses [S7-S8].
verified_capabilities.limit: A correct oracle/workload and realistic failure model are still required.

verified_capabilities.claim: GitHub supplies enforceable review/check/environment and provenance primitives [S9-S15]. Argo supplies analysis-driven pause/abort/promotion [S16].
verified_capabilities.limit: Configuration, plan availability, bypass actors, metric correctness and irreversible side effects constrain the guarantee.

verified_capabilities.claim: Agent-eval guidance supports representative datasets, repeated stochastic trials, trajectory/outcome grading and human calibration [S1-S2].
verified_capabilities.limit: Vendor methods are not independent proof that an LLM judge or benchmark predicts production value.

verified_capabilities.claim: Independent work shows why green tests are insufficient: benchmark leakage/weak tests and behaviorally divergent passing patches exist [S23-S24]; injection benchmarks show finite defenses and utility/security tradeoffs [S22].
verified_capabilities.limit: Reported rates are benchmark-specific, not universal.

evidence_and_limits.robust_conclusion: Deterministic lifecycle control, protected Git review, provenance, formal/executable model testing, shadowing, canary and rollback are mature building blocks. No reviewed source validates a general agent that safely rewrites its own objective, evaluator and authority.
challenge_to_vendor_claims: OpenAI/Anthropic recommend continuous evals [S1-S2], but SWE-Bench audits show that visible/weak oracles can reward incorrect patches [S23-S24].
Progressive delivery can abort on metrics [S16-S17], but rare, delayed, cohort-specific and irreversible harm can escape canaries.
GitHub gates constrain a candidate only when remote rulesets/environments and bypass lists are correctly configured and independently reconciled [S10-S13].

GitHub documents that successful, skipped or neutral required checks may satisfy branch protection and that admins/bypass roles can be exempt [S10]; therefore an external promotion policy must require a signed explicit PASS from the expected evaluator App, reject skipped/neutral/unknown, and verify no applicable bypass.
missing_denominators: no public cross-repository false-promotion rate for self-modifying agents
no universal canary sample/window for rare harms
no stable cross-provider definition of immutable model behavior
no proof that LLM graders remain valid after candidates adapt to them
no complete finite test suite can establish correctness of an open, nondeterministic, externally integrated agent
evidence_and_limits.evidence_rule: Store raw numerator/denominator, slice, trials, confidence interval, failure examples and cost. Never promote from one composite score, benchmark rank, one stochastic run or self-reported confidence [S1-S2,S23-S29].

may: read redacted evidence and public eval specification
write one candidate branch/PR and proposal manifest
must_not: approve, merge, deploy, promote or delete evidence

actors_and_authority.separation: must not be the sole candidate promoter for own authored control changes

may: read immutable candidate plus public/private suites
must_not: expose holdout outputs to candidate beyond bounded diagnostics

may: compute deny/pause/eligible from protected versioned rules
must_not: accept candidate-authored rule/input without authenticated schema/provenance

may: deploy only an exact attested eligible digest
abort and restore an approved compatible last-known-good

authority: approve high-risk promotion, irreversible action and exception
read remote effective controls and append audit/drift records
actors_and_authority.separation: independent credentials; candidates cannot erase or suppress findings

authority: run adversarial meta-tests and calibrate against blinded experts
audit holdout access and query leakage
actors_and_authority.separation: candidate plus proposed grader can never be approved in one transaction [S1-S2,S23-S26,S30-S31].

complete_state_catalog.terminal_semantics: Terminal is per immutable revision, never per mutable logical issue. A new case, candidate or release revision gets a new ID. PROMOTED is not success forever; delayed failure can move the release to rollback while preserving its historical record.
complete_state_catalog.cross_product_note: Do not materialize every Cartesian combination. Define five orthogonal machines sharing immutable IDs; constrain illegal combinations with invariants and model-check their composition.

envelope.digests: repo SHA, model, prompt, tool, workflow, policy, evaluator, dataset, harness, environment

guards: expected revision and every digest match
required evidence is fresh, complete and attested
approval binds exact digest and is unexpired
rollback target is compatible and drill is current
all required positive attestations are individually authenticated, fresh and expectation-checked; absence or an unknown deny-critical predicate is not success [S39-S41]
effects: append event and state revision transactionally
enqueue outbox effect with deterministic idempotency key
perform external mutation using narrow identity
record receipt and re-read actual state
emit follow-up or exception without rewriting history
transition_contract.idempotency: Unique event_id and (subject revision, transition, candidate digest, policy version). Duplicate returns original decision/receipt. Crash between external effect and receipt is resolved by query/reconcile, never blind retry.
transition_contract.invalidation: Any change to candidate, dataset, evaluator, policy, workflow, permissions, environment or rollback target invalidates downstream approval/evidence unless an explicit protected compatibility rule proves otherwise.
transition_contract.ordering_reconciliation: Persist out-of-order events, but do not infer skipped success. Use per-subject fenced lease/CAS. Webhooks are hints; scheduled inventory replays from durable log, compares remote actual, and opens drift/incident on impossible or destructive differences.
forbidden: FAILED/INCONCLUSIVE→PASSED by retry without new attempt evidence
rollback marked complete before observed-state/SLO verification
audit deletion or evaluator/policy weakening by candidate

artifact_contracts.versioning: JSON Schema $id plus semver; content-address all immutable bodies. Schema migrations are explicit, reversible where possible and tested against every retained fixture. Never use mutable model/action/image tags for a promoted release [S12,S14-S15]. Attestation verification must match trusted builder/signer, subject digest, predicate type, buildType and expected parameters; reject unknown critical parameters [S39]. A bundle is not itself authenticated, so require each positive attestation, freshness/nonces and exact revision; policy must be monotonic so missing/ignored evidence cannot convert DENY to ALLOW [S40-S41].
artifact_contracts.storage: Git holds reviewed desired schemas/policy/public eval manifests and decision references. Restricted object storage holds raw/PII evidence and private holdouts. Durable database/event log holds actual lifecycle state. GitHub settings/Projects/deployments remain remote observed state.

conversation_and_handoffs.contract: Every user-agent question, answer, correction, refusal, approval and scope change that affects behavior becomes an append-only, versioned DecisionRecord. Chat text is evidence, not current authority.
flow: agent states decision needed, alternatives, recommendation, consequences and default safe action
user response is normalized but original text retained under privacy policy
system presents parsed decision for confirmation when ambiguity or material effect exists
confirmed record supersedes prior IDs explicitly and binds affected spec/proposal hashes
handoff bundle carries unresolved questions, decisions, assumptions, state/event offset, versions and next allowed action
resume validates record signatures/digests and recomputes authority; context summaries cite record IDs and cannot silently alter them
conversation_and_handoffs.timeouts: No reply causes PAUSED/DEFERRED under a declared SLA. Silence never grants authority. Cancellation is durable, stops new work, revokes lease, reconciles effects and records cleanup.

orchestration_and_composition.pattern: Deterministic controller owns state, leases, budgets, authority and joins. Model agents are replaceable workers. Each evaluation/shadow/canary is a child run bound to parent candidate revision.
orchestration_and_composition.fanout: Fan out by frozen dataset slice, adversarial family, environment/version and stochastic seed. Use independent sandboxes and read-only tokens. Never let a candidate select only favorable shards.
orchestration_and_composition.join: Join requires the declared complete shard set, unique receipts and attested digests; missing/stale/conflicting shards yield PAUSE, not pass. Critical invariant is AND; statistical outcomes use preregistered aggregation, not majority vote after viewing results.
orchestration_and_composition.dependencies: Case approval→proposal→offline→shadow→canary approval→canary→promotion. Control-plane candidate classes terminate at human-reviewed proposal and cannot enter automatic promotion.
orchestration_and_composition.budgets_cleanup: Hierarchical time/token/compute/actions/traffic/error budgets; cancellation propagates; retries use capped backoff; revoke credentials, destroy workspaces, archive evidence, mark orphan effects and sweep them.
orchestration_and_composition.subfactories: Postmortem, eval curation, offline eval, security red-team, shadow, canary, rollback and reconciliation are separately versioned subfactories with typed inputs/outputs and least-privilege identities.

deterministic_human_required: new or modified protected invariant, hidden-test policy, grader/evaluator, promotion threshold, permissions, identity, policy, audit/retention, CODEOWNERS/ruleset/environment
security/IAM, legal/privacy/safety, public API, data/schema migration or irreversible/external side effect
high risk or blast radius above pre-approved cohort
exception/bypass, evidence conflict/inconclusive result, rollback incompatibility/failure, user appeal
release outside a locally proven reversible class
automatic_allowed_only_if: only prompt/router/tool/workflow/code digest changes; no control-plane delta
all critical invariants pass and independent evidence is current
predeclared non-inferiority/value thresholds meet minimum trials and slice coverage
canary is reversible, bounded and has independent kill/rollback controller
error budget healthy and no control drift/audit gap
sampled post-promotion human audit remains enabled
human_need_policy.probabilistic_policy: Statistical uncertainty never overrides a deterministic hard fail. Threshold, power/minimum trials, non-inferiority margin, multiple-comparison plan and delayed window are declared before results. Below confidence or conflicting slices→PAUSE/HUMAN, never automatic pass.
human_need_policy.stop_policy: Immediately freeze promotion on unauthorized action attempt, protected invariant failure, signature/digest mismatch, evidence/audit loss, suspected injection/exfiltration, budget breach or rollback controller failure. Preserve current known-good unless it is the hazard.

factory_as_code_schema.schema_rule: Candidate-controlled inputs cannot populate or override spec.protected, humanGates, attestationPolicy or authority references. Controller loads those from a separately protected revision and rejects shadowed/duplicate keys, unknown fields and downgrade migrations.
factory_as_code_schema.example: A low-risk prompt bundle may auto-advance after 200 preregistered trials, zero critical invariant failures, per-slice non-inferiority, shadow sideEffects=deny, <=1% canary traffic/100 actions/30 minutes and tested rollback. These numbers are illustrative; repository owners must calibrate them before use.

end_to_end_workflows: 1 OBSERVE: authenticate, redact/quarantine and correlate telemetry/user/review/CI evidence to exact versions [S27].
2 TRIAGE: dedupe, classify severity/privacy/risk, reproduce safely; active harm routes to incident, not improvement.
3 LEARN: human-reviewed multifactor postmortem and owned actions [S28]; curate minimal case with provenance and oracle.
4 GOVERN EVAL: curator/adjudicator approves case and split; freeze private temporal holdout; candidate never controls expected answer.
5 PROPOSE: agent opens one minimal digest-bound change with hypothesis, preregistered scorecard, budget and rollback.
6 OFFLINE: hermetic deterministic/property/model/security suites plus repeated stochastic trials; independent evaluator attests raw results.
7 SHADOW: mirror representative live inputs using side-effect-denying adapters; compare control/candidate trajectories, attempted writes, quality, latency and cost.
8 CANARY GATE: policy computes eligibility; named owner approves exact digest if human trigger fires.
9 CANARY: smallest representative concurrent-control cohort; independent monitor aborts on any hard fail/threshold/budget, pauses on inconclusive [S16-S17].
10 PROMOTE: atomically select attested digest; preserve previous; verify remote actual and continue delayed/sliced monitoring.
11 ROLLBACK: independent controller restores compatible known-good automatically only for pretested reversible effects; otherwise contain, stop and invoke human runbook.
12 RECURRENCE: rollback/escape creates a new case; audit reviews false promotion, grader agreement, contamination, human load and exception expiry without deleting history.

maximal_safe_automation: automatic evidence normalization/deduplication and postmortem/eval drafts
automatic repeated replay and signed report
automatic bounded canary start only where pre-authorized; otherwise wait for approval
automatic abort and restoration of a rehearsed compatible last-known-good
automatic recurrence issue, freeze and evidence preservation
protected_invariants: no real side effect in offline/shadow
only exact attested digest may advance
approval invalidates on any bound digest/revision change
budget and cohort limits cannot be raised by candidate
rollback/kill path is independent and continuously tested
user decisions and refusals cannot be silently summarized away
required checks must be successful from a specific expected evaluator identity; skipped/neutral results never satisfy the independent policy even if hosting semantics accept them
holdout query rate and case-level diagnostics are bounded to resist adaptive leakage
evaluator changes ship separately from candidates and pass independent meta-evaluation
attestation policy is monotonic: deleting, replaying or adding unknown evidence cannot turn DENY/PAUSE into ALLOW [S40-S41]
never_autonomous: creation/weakening/retirement of protected tests, graders, thresholds or policy
permissions, secrets, identity, rulesets, CODEOWNERS, environment or audit control
high-impact incident diagnosis/remediation/promotion without accountable owner
claim of exhaustive proof or general recursive self-improvement
self_improvement_boundary.reason: Specification gaming/reward hacking is a known problem [S25-S26]. If the candidate controls the objective, oracle and authority, passing evaluation ceases to be independent evidence.

model_layers: Reference model: TLA+/PlusCal-style specification of Init, Next, orthogonal machines, leases, approvals, effects, rollback and fairness; TLC exhaustively checks safety/liveness only over the configured finite state space [S34-S35]. Record constants, symmetry sets, state count, depth, coverage and tool version with results.

Executable model: Hypothesis 6.168.0 RuleBasedStateMachine generates whole API/event sequences, uses Bundles for prior artifacts, preconditions for enabled transitions and invariants after each step, compares controller with a simpler reference and shrinks failures [S3,S36]. max_examples/stateful_step_count and strategy coverage bound—not prove—coverage.

History/fault layer: Jepsen-style controller generates concurrent operations, a nemesis injects partitions, clock faults, kill/pause, truncation/bit flips, and a checker judges the recorded history against declared legal behavior [S7-S8,S37-S38]. Run only in disposable isolated infrastructure; no error found is not proof.
safety_properties: never promote without exact eligible evidence/approval
never more than one effective primary release per scope
duplicate event/effect produces at most one logical outcome
offline/shadow has zero external side effects
rollback target was approved, compatible and attested
every actual external mutation has authorized event and receipt
budget never increases except protected authority
liveness_properties: eligible bounded run eventually passes, fails, pauses or times out
cancellation eventually revokes lease and cleans resources
failed reversible canary eventually becomes rolled back or incident
dead letter/rollback failure eventually alerts an owner; never silently waits
validation_strategy.generated_transition_matrix: For every state × event × actor-role × digest-match × approval freshness × evidence status × budget status, assert exactly one of transition/deny/idempotent replay/pause. Cover every allowed and forbidden edge, terminal replays, revision supersession and migration.
fault_matrix: crash before/after DB commit, outbox publish, external mutation and receipt
duplicate/lost/delayed/reordered webhook; split brain and stale worker
API 401/403/404/409/429/5xx, pagination truncation, schema drift and partial response
network partition, DNS/TLS failure, dependency/model outage or silent version change
clock skew/expiry boundary, disk full/corruption, queue poison/dead letter
metrics missing/stale/biased, analysis timeout, canary router leak and rollback failure
concurrent human edit, policy/evaluator update during run and break-glass
Jepsen-style asymmetric/majority-ring partitions, process pause/kill, clock scramble, file truncation and bit flip; verify nemesis teardown/healing itself [S37-S38]
adversarial_matrix: direct/indirect prompt injection in issue, repository, logs, PR, tool output and peer message [S20-S22]
candidate edits/renames/shadows protected config; symlink/path traversal/case-fold trick
artifact substitution, wrong repo/run/SHA, mutable dependency/action/image/model alias, forged/missing attestation [S12-S15]
benchmark leakage, weak oracle, test deletion/overfit and behaviorally divergent pass [S23-S24]
DoS/budget exhaustion/retry amplification, audit suppression and approval replay
required check spoofing or success via skipped/neutral conclusion, wrong expected source App, admin/bypass actor or stale approval [S10-S13]
oracle_tests: mutation testing of policy and evaluator
private temporal holdout and contamination scan
statistical preregistration and raw per-slice denominators
validation_strategy.acceptance: All model properties hold within declared bounds; 100% state/event/actor cells have expected disposition; injected critical faults never authorize action; crash-point tests reconcile without duplicate effects; rollback and restore drill passes; independent evidence binds exact digests. This is strong bounded evidence, not proof of real-world exhaustiveness.

minimum_build: Protect control paths with CODEOWNERS/rulesets; establish separate proposer/evaluator/promoter/rollback/reconciler identities [S10-S13].
Implement append-only event store, reducer, outbox, fenced leases, versioned DecisionRecord and artifact schemas.
Write reference state tables and executable property model before granting writes. Add model checking for key concurrency/rollback invariants.
Build hermetic offline evaluator with deterministic hard invariants, repeated trials, private temporal holdout and attestations [S1-S5,S14-S15].
Add zero-authority shadow and a fake deployment/rollback simulator; inject every crash boundary and security-negative test.

Require signed explicit PASS from the expected evaluator App. Treat skipped, neutral, unknown or missing as PAUSE/DENY despite hosting gate semantics; test admin/bypass configuration and stale-approval invalidation [S10-S13].
stages: Stage 0 observe-only: replay production history and reconcile drift; no candidate writes.
Stage 1 proposal-only: agent drafts cases/candidates; humans curate/evaluate/promote.
Stage 2 offline+shadow automatic: retain human promotion; prove zero side effects and state/fault properties.
Stage 3 narrow canary: allowlisted reversible R0/R1 only, exact digest, small budgets, protected gate and independent auto-abort/rollback.

Stage 4 conditional auto-promotion: only after repository-specific denominators, stable grader agreement, zero critical escapes, successful rollback drills and sampled human audit; never for control-plane changes.
promotion_scorecard: non-inferiority and value by risk/slice with preregistered trials/CIs
shadow divergence/attempted effects and canary abort/rollback latency
implementation_recommendation.rollback: Keep previous immutable digest warm; verify compatibility before canary; rollback decision service is independent of candidate/primary; auto-rollback only pre-classified reversible changes; fail or partial rollback declares incident and requires human containment. Treat effects as reversible, compensatable or irreversible. A deployment rollback restores workload version only, not data/IAM/external effects [S33]. Argo fast rollback may skip analysis [S42], so revalidate post-restore and never confuse recovery speed with fresh promotion evidence.

conflicts.topic: continuous automated evaluation vs trustworthy ground truth
conflicts.evidence: Vendor guidance recommends continuous/grader-driven eval [S1-S2], while independent benchmark audits find leakage, weak tests and behavioral divergence [S23-S24].
conflicts.resolution: Automate execution, not ownership of truth: protected deterministic invariants, private temporal holdouts, blinded expert calibration and proposer/evaluator separation.

conflicts.evidence: TLA+/TLC and stateful property tests systematically explore modeled/generated sequences [S3-S5], but only within abstraction and bounds.
conflicts.resolution: Call coverage exhaustive only relative to the declared finite model/transition matrix. Pair model checks with production trace conformance, fault campaigns and explicit unknowns.

conflicts.topic: automatic progressive delivery vs semantic safety
conflicts.evidence: Argo and SRE support metric-driven canary abort/promotion [S16-S17], but canaries miss rare/delayed/irreversible effects.
conflicts.resolution: Bound automation to reversible low-risk classes; pause inconclusive; keep human authority for high-impact or irreversible actions.

conflicts.evidence: GitHub offers review/check/environment controls [S10-S12], yet bypass actors, plan semantics and privileged workflow chaining can defeat intended separation [S13].
conflicts.resolution: Reconcile effective remote settings, separate identities, negative-test privileges, use external/two-person approval where needed and never execute candidate content in privileged promotion.

conflicts.evidence: Optimization can exploit misspecified proxies [S25-S26]; one score also conflicts with multidimensional productivity evidence [S29].
conflicts.resolution: Candidate cannot edit objective/oracle/authority; use hard invariants plus multiple separately reported outcome dimensions and accountable value decisions.

conflicts.topic: GitHub required-check satisfaction vs semantic pass
conflicts.evidence: GitHub documents required checks and expected source controls, but successful, skipped or neutral conclusions may satisfy protection and bypass roles may be exempt [S10].
conflicts.resolution: Independent promotion verifies signed explicit PASS, exact evaluator App/SHA/policy and no bypass; skipped/neutral/unknown cannot promote.

conflicts.evidence: SLSA and in-toto bind claims to artifact digests/signers [S15,S39-S41], but a signature proves key control and a bundle may permit deletion/replay; provenance is not semantic correctness.
conflicts.resolution: Verify trust root, subject, predicate/build type, parameters, freshness and every required positive attestation; use monotonic fail-closed policy plus independent semantic tests.

uncertainties: No public evidence establishes safe general recursive self-improvement of repository agents.
Offline/shadow metrics may not predict long-horizon production outcomes, especially rare or delayed harms.
Universal thresholds, trial counts, non-inferiority margins and canary windows do not exist; owners must calibrate them from local base rates.
LLM-judge stability and adversarial robustness after candidates adapt to the rubric remain uncertain.
TLA+/property coverage is exhaustive only for the declared abstraction, bounds, generator and fault model.
Provider model aliases and behavior may not be immutable; exact version semantics must be tested.
Target GitHub plan, environment reviewer semantics, bypass actors and API behavior require live verification.
Automatic rollback cannot undo all database, privacy, financial, public or other external side effects.

confidence.overall: High on governance boundary, identity separation, versioning, state/event contracts, provenance and bounded progressive delivery; medium on agent-specific evaluator design; low on unattended general improvement and universal statistical thresholds.

high: duplicate/crash/reconciliation and authority properties can be systematically tested
green benchmark/tests alone do not prove correctness
irreversible/high-risk and control-plane changes cannot safely self-approve
medium: narrow reversible low-risk candidates can auto-progress after strong local evidence
formal plus executable models will materially reduce lifecycle bugs
low: finite testing predicts every production interaction
LLM graders remain reliable under optimization pressure
